subject: Follow-up: Deployment mode and pricing for VeloxAI
messages:
From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@velox.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@velox.ai>
Date: 2026-10-12T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up: Deployment mode and pricing for VeloxAI

Hi Aditya / Marissa —

Thanks for the demo today — solid overview and helpful context. Quick recap from our side and a few asks so your team can build a short cost model: 

- What we are trying to solve: embed LLM-powered search and summarization into our customer support console (multi-tenant SaaS).
- Expected production usage (starting): ~10M tokens/month, expected to grow 2-3x in 12 months.
- Latency SLO: 95th percentile around 200ms for short prompt flows.
- Throughput: typical sustained ~8–12 r/s per region, peaks to ~30 r/s during daily spikes.
- Compliance: SOC2 required; some customers will request data residency in us-east or us-west.
- Primary question: which deployment mode makes sense (Hosted API vs Dedicated reserved capacity vs Private VPC/on-prem) given cost, latency, and compliance tradeoffs?

Could you send: 
1) A short cost comparison (hosted per-token vs Dedicated reserved commit economics vs ballpark Private deployment onboarding + infra ops estimate).
2) Any constraints for model choices (e.g., if we need quantized variants for Dedicated or Private).
3) Typical onboarding timelines for Dedicated and Private (VPC/on-prem) — we have customers with procurement cycles of 30–60 days, so timeline matters.

If easier, happy to schedule a 30-min follow-up Wed/Thu next week.

Thanks,
Alex
VP Product, VeloxAI

--
Alex Chen
VeloxAI

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@velox.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-12T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Deployment mode and pricing for VeloxAI

Alex — really appreciate the clear recap. Great pairing on the call. TL;DR: we'll put together a concise pricing deck and a delta comparison across Hosted, Dedicated (reserved commits), and Private VPC, plus a short onboarding timeline.

A few clarifying q's that will materially change the cost model:
- Peak concurrency and typical request/response token distribution (avg input tokens / output tokens). If you have a sample prompt profile we can use, send it.
- Are you planning to pin a single model family (e.g., 13B instruction-tuned) or allow fallbacks to cheaper families for lower quality paths?
- Any data retention / logging window requirements (we can exclude logs to reduce cost).

Next steps:
1) I'll attach an initial pricing estimate (Hosted per-token + Dedicated reserved monthly breakouts + Private one-time onboarding + monthly infra OPEX) — see attached xlsx.
2) Marissa / Neha — can you review the estimate and help flag anything we should escalate to infra/eng (private onboarding complexity, data residency steps)?
3) Alex — if that looks useful we can lock a 30-min follow-up Wed 10/14 at 11am PT to walk through the numbers and run a sensitivity view.

Attachments: 20261012_redwood_pricing_estimate.xlsx, SOC2-evidence-summary.pdf

Best,
Aditya
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-12T13:22:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Follow-up: Deployment mode and pricing for VeloxAI

Aditya / Neha — forwarding Alex's notes and the attached estimate. Quick internal thoughts: 

- Hosted: easiest and fastest to get started; per-token will likely be simplest for their early volumes. We'll show 3 scenarios in the workbook (base 10M tokens, 2x, 3x) and include latency expectations for our verified model profiles.
- Dedicated (Reserved): if they want predictable spend + better tail latency under batching, we should show a 12-month commit option with monthly amortized GPU cost + reserved discount. Need to confirm expected steady-state qps (we should use their 8–12 r/s as baseline).
- Private VPC / On-prem: list as recommended for customers with strict residency and/or full control; include one-time integration fee (professional services + infra set-up) and ongoing infra OPEX estimate; note KMS/HSM integration and audit-log delivery will add time.

Action items for infra/eng (cc Neha): can you enumerate: 1) typical timeline for Private VPC (low-touch vs on-prem), 2) any limitations on model quantization we need to call out, 3) a checklist for SOC2 evidence we can share?

I'll review the estimate and send back line-item comments by EOD.

— Marissa
Director, Solutions | Redwood Inference

From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@velox.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@velox.ai>
Date: 2026-10-12T16:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Deployment mode and pricing for VeloxAI

Thanks Aditya — appreciate the quick turnaround. Wed 10/14 11am PT works for us.

A couple of asks ahead of the call that will help our procurement and infra teams: 
- Please include a per-month cost table for Hosted (per-token) at our base usage and for 2x/3x growth.
- For Dedicated reserved commits: show both a 6-month and 12-month commit option, and include the monthly amortized GPU and license costs.
- For Private: ballpark one-time integration cost and a 3-year TCO estimate (hardware + support) — we have a few enterprise customers who will require on-prem eventually.

Also, can you confirm SOC2 evidence cadence and if Redwood will support vendor questionnaires (we may need a signed attestation)? The SOC2 summary in your attachment looks helpful but procurement will want a few clarifications.

Looking forward to the session — please share the workbook ahead of the call so we can surface questions.

Best,
Alex

On Wed, Oct 14, 2026 at 11:00 AM PT, Meeting happened: Follow-up deep-dive (internal)
Participants: Aditya Rao (Redwood), Marissa Cole (Redwood), Neha Kapoor (Redwood), Alex Chen (VeloxAI), Samir Patel (VeloxAI)
Notes:
- Walked through the attached pricing workbook; highlighted that Hosted per-token is lowest friction but sensitive to usage growth; Dedicated becomes cost-effective around sustained 30M+ tokens/mo with our reserved commits.
- Private/on-prem recommended for customers with strict residency and who need full data plane control — typical onboarding 6–10 weeks for VPC, longer for on-prem if infra procurement required.
- Action items: Aditya to send final pricing workbook with 6/12-month commit comparisons and 3-year TCO for Private. Marissa to collect SOC2 evidence checklist and Neha to quantify infra onboarding timeline.

End of thread summary (meeting 2026-10-14 18:15:00-07:00)
